text: Nope, not doing that. That's not what I asked. I just said I found a better deal. Why does it have to be *exactly* one of those two things? Can't you just take it back? I want the refund. That's the point. Just cancel it. What do I need to say?
zh: 不行，不这么做。这不是我想要的。我只是说我发现了一个更好的优惠。为什么必须*正好*是那两个中的一个？你不能直接收回去吗？我想要退款。这才是重点。直接取消就行。我需要说什么？
